config.marieslib.title: MariesLib Configuration
config.marieslib.overview.gameplayHint: Configure gameplay mods from Mods menu → [mod] → Config
config.marieslib.scanner.toolsHint: Run /<yourmod> scan_analysis for bulk classification (e.g. /nourished scan_analysis).
config.marieslib.scanner.confidenceSprea: Minimum score spread required for the scanner to accept a classification.
config.marieslib.scanner.compositeRatioT: Minimum ratio for composite multi-value classification results.
config.marieslib.scanner.enableRecipeInh: Infer source classifications from crafting recipe ingredients.
config.marieslib.scanner.multiValueInher: Minimum weight for secondary value groups inherited from recipes.
config.marieslib.scanner.multipliers.com: Score multiplier when a community datapack tag matches.
config.marieslib.scanner.multipliers.suf: Score multiplier for item name suffix patterns.
config.marieslib.scanner.multipliers.key: Score multiplier for keyword token matches.
config.marieslib.scanner.multipliers.arc: Score multiplier for archetype pattern matches.
config.marieslib.scanner.multipliers.rec: Score multiplier applied to recipe-inherited classifications.
config.marieslib.scanner.multipliers.nam: Score multiplier for peer items in the same namespace.
config.marieslib.scanner.multipliers.sec: Score multiplier for secondary suffix matches.
config.marieslib.scanner.multipliers.nam: Blend weight when averaging peer namespace scores.
config.marieslib.diagnostics.enableDebug: Write verbose MariesLib diagnostics to the game log.
config.marieslib.diagnostics.hint: Use /<yourmod> diagnostics for datapack validation (e.g. /nourished diagnostics).
config.marieslib.tools.commandStatus: §7/marieslib status§r — Show library version and bootstrap mode
config.marieslib.importExport.groupTitle: Share MariesLib scanner and diagnostics settings as a file or code.
config.marieslib.importExport.import.not: Parse a share code or load a file first
config.marieslib.presets.listLabel.desc: Load or save setting snapshots. Presets are owned by the active Marie mod.
config.marieslib.presets.delete.title: Delete preset?
config.marieslib.presets.delete.message: Delete preset "%s"? This cannot be undone.
